public_holidays: 7 January 2026: regional non-working holiday for San Nicolás de Tumbes independence proclamation. 24 July: compensable regional holiday for the Battle of Zarumilla.

sources.title: Peru official past 2026 regional holidays
sources.authority: Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros / Gob.pe
sources.supports: Read directly: named 2026 regional non-working dates, local scope and statutory/ordinance references where published. Private-sector application may require agreement with the employer.

culture-cycles.note: Read directly: these are the official calendar's past 2026 listings, not a claim of 2027 recurrence or uniform closure of tourist services. The portal says non-working days may apply to private employers by agreement; exact sector coverage and current local implementing acts not yet checked.
